caption: The drawing is composed of two main triangular metal objects rendered in shades of gray on a beige, aged-looking background. The upper half of the page features a side view and a front view of a triangular metal object with rounded corners, a thick outline, and an inner diagonal support bar running from one side to the opposite corner. There are faint pencil lines suggesting measurements and construction lines surrounding this object, including a scale for reference. Below, occupying the lower half of the page, is a larger depiction of a similar triangular object, shown from a slightly elevated, three-quarters angle. This object also has three bars forming a triangle, with an inner support bar running similarly from one side to the opposite corner, and its ends are slightly bent downward. Some additional faint lines and the artist's signature "H. MARALIAN" are present in the bottom right corner. The background includes small brownish spots and discolorations, especially along the left and top edges.
title: Trivet
